risk_reasons: R3 operation markers: secret注入, GITHUB_TOKEN
why_not_autonomous: R3 operation or structural decision: R3 operation markers: secret注入, GITHUB_TOKEN; R2 operation markers: allow-?list
alternatives_considered: owning shared Plugin from remedy_routes: none
new shared Skill/Plugin: not selected (no new_asset_justification; last resort)
setting/harness remedy without owner → consumer configuration guidance (authority records, consumers apply as project change)
existing_capabilities: GitHub Actions: workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` default, environment protection rules (required reviewers before secrets), first-time-contributor approval, full-SHA action pinning, OIDC instead of long-lived secrets — official secure-use guide
Claude Code GitHub Action / Codex action versions with the comment-and-control fix (Claude Code ≥ 2.1.128 per vendor advisory) and tool allowlists
Dependabot for the GitHub Actions ecosystem to keep pinned SHAs updated
options: A: harden every agent-invoking workflow: least-privilege permissions (contents:read; pull-requests:write only where needed), no pull_request_target/workflow_run fork checkout, untrusted inputs only via env, environment protection for jobs holding secrets, full-SHA pins, agent action version floor, tool allowlist; Dependabot for actions
B: only pin + permissions (no environment protection) — cheaper but secret injection before approval remains
C: move agent workflows to a separate repository/app with scoped tokens (larger change, only if A is insufficient)
D: status quo — rejected while any workflow with secrets can read PR/issue text
proposed_action: A per consumer repository, one PR per workflow file with the diff shown to the owner; not autonomous because it changes secret exposure and CI permissions (R3: GITHUB_TOKEN, secret injection).
evaluation_plan: checklist per workflow: permissions block present and minimal; no pull_request_target with fork checkout; secrets only in protected environments; all `uses:` pinned to full SHA; agent action ≥ fixed version. Verify by re-running each workflow once (must pass) and by a negative test: an issue comment containing a prompt-injection string must not reach secret-holding steps. Rollback = revert the workflow file.

evidence.summary: GITHUB_TOKEN read-only既定、pull_request_target/workflow_runでのfork checkout回避、untrusted inputはenv経由、環境保護でsecretに承認、full SHA pinのみ不変、OIDC推奨。AI agent固有記述なし
Comment-and-Control系: PR title/issue body/commentからのinjectionでsecret読出し。修正2.1.128（2026-05-05）。緩和: Rule of Two、key per workflow、tool allowlist、system prompt hardening、token監視・rotation
Claude Code Security Review/Gemini CLI Action/Copilot Agentが同一手法で乗っ取り可能と開示、hardened Actions設定（permissions、environment protection、first-time contributor gate）で遮断
-p headlessではtrust verification無効、network commandは既定非自動許可
